item.title: Victim identified in semi-truck crash, police say
item.description: DOTHAN, Ala (WDHN) -- One person is dead after a semi-truck crash on a busy Dothan highway Sunday night, according to Dothan Police. Coroner Robert Byrd identified the victim as 18-year-old David Tice. Dothan Police say Tice was crossing Montgomery Highway from La Parilla when he was hit by a semi-truck in the southbound lane. item.description: DOTHAN, Ala (WDHN) -- Governor Ivey announced Friday that the State Industrial Development Authority (SIDA) has approved 21 grants totaling $15.7 million under the Site Evaluation and Economic Development Strategy (SEEDS) program. item.description: DOTHAN, Ala (WDHN) -- WDHN confirmed with an employee Monday that the popular Dothan restaurant, Mexican Connection, closed suddenly on Saturday after 40 years of business.
